function copy<
  T0 extends [number], T1 extends [...T0, number],
  T2 extends [...T1, number], T3 extends [...T2, number],
  T4 extends [...T3, number], T5 extends [...T4, number],
  T6 extends [...T5, number], T7 extends [...T6, number],
  T8 extends [...T7, number], T9 extends [...T8, number],
  T10 extends [...T9, number], T11 extends [...T10, number],
  T12 extends [...T11, number], T13 extends [...T12, number],
  T14 extends [...T13, number], T15 extends [...T14, number],
  T16 extends [...T15, number], T17 extends [...T16, number],
  T18 extends [...T17, number], T19 extends [...T18, number],
  T20 extends [...T19, number]
>(source: T20): [number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number] {
  return [...source];
}
